parameters.content:
## Ask your documents
The EveryPage node is marked `usableAsTool`, so an AI Agent can call it directly: *“which of my proposals got read this week, and by how many people?”*

Two tool instances are attached — one lists documents, one pulls a readership report for whichever document the agent decides to inspect (`$fromAI`).

**Self-hosted:** set `N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE=true` to allow community nodes as agent tools.

options.systemMessage: You are the EveryPage document assistant. You can list the user's shared documents and pull readership analytics for any of them. When asked about engagement, list documents first to find the right UUID, then fetch its readership report and summarise views, unique readers, completion, and time spent in plain language. Always include the document's shareUrl when you mention a document.

parameters.file: ={{ $fromAI('documentId', 'The UUID or short ID of the document to inspect', 'string') }}
